editionLabel: British Go Association Tournament rules of play - 31 March 2009 (English)
firstPlayerRule: In an even game, Black moves first from an empty board. In a handicap game, White moves first after all handicap stones have been placed.
clarifications: Colors must already have been assigned; the cited setup and play sections do not select who receives Black or White.
Section 4 places handicap stones on the star points in the traditional Japanese pattern unless otherwise stated. Handicap placement is completed before White's first turn.

internalEvidence: Read the complete relevant setup, play and handicap passages, not an isolated opening sentence. The eight-page publisher-hosted PDF was extracted; PDF/printed pages 1 and 2 were rendered with Poppler and visually inspected. The cover says 31/03/2009. Page 2 scopes this document to BGA tournament play, giving it priority over its referenced AGA rules if meanings conflict. Section 2 explicitly separates an empty-board even start from the post-handicap White turn; Section 4 specifies default placement. Cached at research/source-files/traditional-games/go-bga-2009.pdf, SHA-256 f514d26efe7ba0edf4ce4e7e4f6aef1473be5b2e12bd65791a549edd204aab76. Identity Q11413 / BGG 188. This is a draft, with no approval or portable-pool eligibility.
uncertainty: The inspected dated document is the BGA 31 March 2009 ruleset, not a claim about the latest rules or every national Go ruleset.
The cited opening sections do not supply a color-selection method, so no coin toss, nigiri procedure or weaker-player assignment is invented.
